en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view from a riverbank looking across a broad river toward a European town. In the foreground are a rocky shoreline and a dirt path with grass. On the opposite bank stand industrial buildings with tall smokestacks, small riverside structures, boats moored along the shore, and a dense cluster of townhouses. Above the town rises a large church with a steeply pitched roof and a tall baroque-style tower or spire. To the right, on a hill surrounded by trees, is a castle‑like complex or manor with two towers. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century Central or Eastern European riverside town. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.
